Method of Attack: Custom-made tools to scan for, compromise, and control ICS/SCADA devices
Exploitation of CVE-2020-15368 to target Windows systems with ASRock motherboards and spread laterally into OT and IT environments
Impacted Systems: Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA) servers
Industrial Internet technologies like CoDeSyS, Modbus, OPC UA
Attack Vector: Compromising ICS/SCADA devices after gaining initial access to the operational technology (OT) network
Privilege escalation and lateral movement within OT environments
